blockingIssues.description: apps/web/src/App.test.tsx still asserts the original baseline shell copy instead of the current validator-facing dashboard behavior, so the feature's web smoke coverage is stale against the actual scaffold.
packages/shared/src/platform.test.ts still checks obsolete webShellCards titles that the current web surface no longer consumes, leaving the promised smoke-validation traceability out of date.

packages/db/drizzle/0000_domain_core.sql omits foreign-key constraints for reference fields such as activeImportId, activeBuildRunId, activeCheckpointId, and currentStepId even though the schema models them as durable relationships.

The base db migration also omits several nullable relation foreign keys (including normalized node, claim, and Zotero source links), so fresh databases created from the base migration can persist orphaned references contrary to the feature contract.

rejectedObservations.observation: Document which UI/API strings are intended to remain stable validator contracts versus feature copy that can evolve.
rejectedObservations.reason: ambiguous: the review evidence identifies a useful distinction, but the exact durable contract should be decided by the orchestrator rather than recorded as factual library guidance without a repo-wide policy.

rejectedObservations.observation: Add worker guidance requiring parity checks between Drizzle schema references and generated SQL migrations after generation.
rejectedObservations.reason: recommend-to-orchestrator instead: this is a procedural skill/AGENTS.md change rather than a factual services or library update that scrutiny should apply directly.
